Experienced Heart Doctor in Meerut: Dr. Gurjeet Singh Gill se Jaaniye Dil ki Sehat ke Raaz

Namaste, main Dr. Gurjeet Singh Gill hoon, ek cardiac physician. Pichhle kai saalon se main Meerut aur aas-paas ke ilaakon mein dil ke mareezon ka ilaaj kar raha hoon. Aaj main aapko dil ki sehat ke baare mein kuch zaroori baatein batana chahta hoon. Agar aap Meerut, Delhi NCR ya aas-paas ke kisi bhi ilaake se hain aur aapko dil se judi koi bhi problem hai, toh yeh blog aapke liye hai.

Dil ki bimariyan aaj kal aam ho gayi hain. Lekin sahi samay par sahi ilaaj aur lifestyle changes se aap apne dil ko healthy rakh sakte hain. Is blog mein main aapke kuch aam sawaalon ke jawab dunga, jo mere paas aksar patients poochte hain. Toh chaliye shuru karte hain.

❓ Patient Question: "Doctor sahab, mere seene mein dard hota hai, kya yeh heart attack hai?"

🩺 Dr. Gill's Answer: Yeh ek bahut common sawaal hai. Seene mein dard hone ke kai kaaran ho sakte hain. Har seene ka dard heart attack nahi hota. Lekin agar dard chest ke beech mein hai, dabav jaisa lagta hai, aur yeh dard baayein hath, kandhe, jabde ya peeth tak jata hai, toh yeh heart attack ka lakshan ho sakta hai. Iske saath pasina aana, saans phoolna, ulti jaisa mann hona bhi ho sakta hai. Aise lakshan dikhne par turant doctor se milein. Main aapko salah dunga ki ignore na karein. Gill Heart Clinic mein hum ECG, Echo, TMT jaise test karke sahi diagnosis karte hain. Agar aap Meerut mein hain, toh bina der kiye mujhse consult karein. Heart attack mein har minute kimti hota hai. Isliye samay par ilaaj zaroori hai.

❓ Patient Question: "Doctor, main 45 saal ka hoon, mera BP high rehta hai. Kya mujhe heart attack ka risk hai?"

🩺 Dr. Gill's Answer: Ji haan, high BP (hypertension) heart attack ka ek bada risk factor hai. Agar aapka BP 140/90 se zyada rehta hai, toh aapko heart attack, stroke, aur kidney problems ka khatra hota hai. Lekin ghabrane ki baat nahi hai. Sahi dawa, diet aur lifestyle se BP control mein rakha ja sakta hai. Aapko namak kam karna chahiye, exercise karni chahiye, aur stress kam karna chahiye. PM Jan Aushadhi generic medicines se aapko sasti dawa mil sakti hai. Main aapko regular BP check karne ki salah dunga. Agar aap Meerut mein hain, toh Gill Heart Clinic aa sakte hain. Yahan hum aapka BP monitor karte hain aur zaroorat ke hisaab se dawa dete hain. Yaad rakhein, BP control mein rakhna aapke dil ki raksha karta hai.

❓ Patient Question: "Doctor, meri umar 60 saal hai, mujhe saans phoolne ki shikayat hai. Kya yeh heart ki problem hai?"

🩺 Dr. Gill's Answer: 60 saal ki umar mein saans phoolna heart ki problem ho sakti hai, lekin yeh lungs, anemia, ya thyroid ki wajah se bhi ho sakta hai. Agar saans phoolna chalne par ya letne par badhta hai, toh yeh heart failure ka lakshan ho sakta hai. Heart failure mein dil pump karne mein kamzor ho jata hai. Iske liye Echo test zaroori hai. Main aapko salah dunga ki turant kisi heart specialist se milein. Gill Heart Clinic mein hum aise cases ka sahi ilaaj karte hain. Agar aap Meerut ya Delhi NCR mein hain, toh mujhse consult karein. Sahi samay par ilaaj se aapki zindagi better ho sakti hai.

❓ Patient Question: "Doctor, kya cholesterol badhne se heart attack hota hai?"

🩺 Dr. Gill's Answer: Ji haan, high cholesterol, khaas kar LDL (kharab cholesterol) heart attack ka bada risk factor hai. Yeh arteries mein plaque banata hai, jisse blood flow block ho jata hai. Lekin cholesterol ko diet aur dawa se control kiya ja sakta hai. Aapko ghee, tel, fried food kam karna chahiye. Aur zyada fiber, fruits, sabziyan khani chahiye. Statin dawaen cholesterol kam karti hain. PM Jan Aushadhi se aapko sasti generic statin mil sakti hai. Regular lipid profile test karate rahein. Agar aap Meerut mein hain, toh Gill Heart Clinic mein hum aapka cholesterol check karte hain aur sahi salah dete hain.

❓ Patient Question: "Doctor, heart attack ke baad kya karna chahiye?"

🩺 Dr. Gill's Answer: Heart attack ke baad lifestyle mein badlav bahut zaroori hai. Aapko doctor ki batayi hui dawaen regular leni chahiye. Diet mein namak, tel, cheeni kam karein. Exercise karein, lekin doctor ki salah se. Smoking aur alcohol bilkul band karein. Stress kam karein. Regular checkup karate rahein. Gill Heart Clinic mein hum heart attack ke baad rehabilitation aur follow-up care dete hain. Agar aap Meerut ya Delhi NCR mein hain, toh hum aapki poori madad karenge.

❓ Patient Question: "Doctor, kya heart ki bimariyan hereditary hoti hain?"

🩺 Dr. Gill's Answer: Ji haan, agar aapke parivar mein kisi ko heart attack hua hai, khaas kar 55 saal se pehle, toh aapko bhi risk ho sakta hai. Lekin yeh zaroori nahi ki aapko bhi ho. Aap healthy lifestyle follow karke risk kam kar sakte hain. Regular checkup, healthy diet, exercise, aur stress management se aap apne dil ko bacha sakte hain. Agar aapko family history hai, toh aapko aur bhi zyada dhyan dena chahiye. Gill Heart Clinic mein hum aise patients ka special screening karte hain.

🩺 Dr. Gill's Clinical Experience

Gill Heart Clinic, Mohiuddinpur, Meerut mein maine kai patients ko dekha hai. Ek 55 saal ke patient the, unhe chest pain tha. Unki ECG normal thi, lekin TMT mein problem aayi. Angiography karne par ek artery mein 90% block mila. Humne unka angioplasty karaya, aur aaj woh bilkul theek hain. Ek aur patient, 40 saal ki mahila, unhe palpitations thi. Holter monitor se pata chala ki unhe arrhythmia hai. Unka ilaaj kiya gaya aur ab woh normal hain. Aise kai cases mere paas aate hain. Sahi diagnosis aur samay par ilaaj se hum kai zindagiyan bacha sakte hain.

Indian Diet and Lifestyle Advice

Indian diet mein kuch cheezein heart ke liye achhi hoti hain, jaise dal, sabziyan, fruits, whole grains. Lekin kuch cheezein se bachna chahiye: zyada tel, ghee, fried food, namak, cheeni, processed food. Aapko apni diet mein fiber badhana chahiye. Roz 30 minute exercise karein. Stress kam karne ke liye yoga, meditation karein. Smoking aur alcohol bilkul band karein. PM Jan Aushadhi generic medicines se aapko sasti dawa mil sakti hai, jo quality mein bhi achhi hoti hai. Iske liye aap apne nazdeeki Jan Aushadhi store se dawa le sakte hain.

FAQ

Q: Kya heart attack ke baad sex kar sakte hain?

A: Ji haan, lekin doctor se pooch kar. Agar aapki condition stable hai, toh kuch hafte baad aap sex kar sakte hain. Lekin pehle apne cardiologist se salah lein.

Q: Kya heart ki bimari ka ilaaj ayurvedic se ho sakta hai?

A: Ayurvedic dawaen kuch had tak madad kar sakti hain, lekin heart attack jaise emergency mein allopathic ilaaj hi asardar hai. Kisi bhi dawa ko shuru karne se pehle apne doctor se poochein.

Q: Kya heart checkup ke liye khaali pet aana zaroori hai?

A: Kuch test jaise lipid profile ke liye 12 ghante ka fasting zaroori hai. Lekin ECG, Echo ke liye fasting ki zaroorat nahi. Aap clinic aane se pehle confirm kar lein.

Q: Kya heart specialist ko dikhane ke liye appointment zaroori hai?

A: Ji haan, appointment se aapko wait nahi karna padta. Aap Gill Heart Clinic mein phone ya online appointment le sakte hain.
